scope: Fresh depolarising simulation on all 680 non-mirrored Qermit targets, one fixed acquisition per target. The archived raw, ZNE and CDR estimates come from a separate acquisition.
acquisition: February 2022 Qermit task graph with pytket 0.19.2 and pytket-qiskit 0.22.1. Aer returned count histograms. The captured native fit inputs are finite-shot expectations. Channel-mean diagnostics use a separate density calculation.
estimand: Within each family, width and depth cell, compute each target’s absolute error divided by the fresh raw absolute error, then take the median and maximum. Count strict improvements over the baseline cell statistic. Count undefined cells separately.
source_check: Checked all 680 experiment IDs, circuit IDs, families, mirror flags, widths, depths, ideal targets and raw/CDR/ZNE archival estimates against the independent release digest. All 204 archive cell–method rows reproduce the source-linked published reference.

channel_mean_diagnostic.range_rule: Inclusive minimum and maximum of the 20 auxiliary channel means, before shot sampling.
channel_mean_diagnostic.fit: Affine fit of exact ideal labels to noisy channel means, evaluated at the target channel mean.
